svg.title: How OpenPI fits into Pi
svg.desc: You work in the Pi terminal or the OpenPI Web workbench. Both drive a parent Pi session that keeps your provider, models, tools, Skills and Trust. OpenPI adds a fixed resident tool set at Pi extension seams. The parent delegates to Pi Bash for long-running processes, to subagents (in-process Pi SDK sessions with isolated context and optional worktrees), or to workflows (a sandboxed script with phase, agent, parallel and pipeline primitives, a journal, safe replay and artifacts). Results flow back to the parent automatically.
